import json, re, random, sys, time, chess, os
D = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
RE = [(re.compile(p), r) for p, r in json.load(open(os.path.join(D, "re.json")))]
def run(fen):
    for p, r in RE: fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in fen.split("\n")]
def expected(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen); s = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN: continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m); s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s
ex = "rnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P5/q4Kb1 w kq - 0 1"
out = run(ex)
want = "rnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P1K3/q5b1 b kq - 0 0\nrnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P3K1/q5b1 b kq - 0 0\nrnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P4/P1P5/q2Q1Kb1 b kq - 0 0"
assert sorted(out) == sorted(" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in want.split("\n")), out
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0)
n = 0; t = time.time(); bad = 0
for g in range(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 300):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply() < 300:
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE:
            fen = b.fen(); exp = expected(fen); got = run(fen); n += 1
            ok = len(got) == len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp for x in got)
            if not ok:
                bad += 1
                print("FAIL", fen, sorted(set(got) - exp), sorted(exp - set(got)))
                if bad > 5: sys.exit(1)
        ms = list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias towards captures/castling/pawn moves for coverage
        pref = [m for m in ms if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(pref) if pref and random.random() < 0.7 else random.choice(ms))
print("positions", n, "bad", bad, "time/pos", (time.time() - t) / max(n, 1))
